sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- A.K.Sharma Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
List revised.
No one appears on behalf of the appellant to press this appeal.
Sri A.K. Sharma, learned counsel for the accused-respondent is also not present.
Sri B.B. Upadhyay, learned State counsel is present, who has been heard.

The present appeal has been filed by the appellant against the judgement and order dated 17.2.1979 passed by the A.C.J.M., Agra, acquitting the accused-respondent in Criminal Case No. 1740 of 1976,
under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
As per office report dated 2.2.2022, a report from C.J.M. concerned dated 24.6.2021 has been received stating therein that the accused-respondent has died.

In support of which a report of Nagar Swasthya Adhikari, Nagar ... vs Mohar Singh on 26 September, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72104462/
1 concerned police station and the copy of the statements of the witnesses have also been annexed thereto.
